summary: Preserved candidate PR 2743's valid dynamic DFlash2 scheduling and ragged-verification work, reproduced review PR 2794's missing trained confidence-head and STS paths at exact commit 9a7fdb8c7f520ec561be7c7f45a4a5352cc7a7a3, and added opt-in checkpoint head construction/loading/inference plus per-position STS calibration. Head-less checkpoints continue to use selector-lattice confidence.

tests.command: git grep source audit at candidate 9a7fdb8 plus pytest of the five new regression tests against that exact checkout
tests.what_was_measured: The candidate contained no DFlash2 trained-head or STS implementation; all five head/loading/calibration regressions failed before the correction. See candidate-source-reproduction.log and failing-before.log.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-88cd1a000c03/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-88cd1a000c03/test_dflash_confidence_regression.py -k 'trained_head or dflash_sts_loader or enabled_confidence_head'
tests.what_was_measured: The identical five regressions passed after the correction: trained-head inference, strict checkpoint-weight loading, STS loading, head-less STS rejection, and head precedence over selector fallback.
74 tests and 18 subtests passed for DFlash confidence/configuration, logits compatibility, shared scheduler behavior, and STS parsing/application.
One ROCm GPU test with 22 subtests passed against independent PyTorch references for shared scheduling/verify kernels.

tests.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 inline DFlash trained-head plus STS numerical comparison
tests.what_was_measured: On AMD Instinct MI355X, calibrated head probabilities matched an independent sigmoid(logit / per-position-temperature) reference exactly.

tests.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 pytest ragged verify/backend capability and DFlash overlap/buffer compatibility suites; compileall; git diff --check
tests.what_was_measured: 26 tests and 3 subtests passed; modified Python compiled and the patch was whitespace-clean.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X executed the corrected confidence-head/STS numerical reference and the shared kernel parity suite (22 GPU subtests).

remaining_limitations: No compatible DFlash2 target/draft checkpoint or trained confidence-head checkpoint was supplied or cached, so real model weight loading and end-to-end DFlash2 serving were not run.
Lossless end-to-end semantics for sampling, grammar, continuous batching, overlap relay, and live compact graph replay remain unverified without a compatible DFlash2 model pair.
Mixed-workload throughput remains unmeasured locally; no claim is made from the tiny Llama transport fixture because it cannot qualify DFlash2 architecture or semantics.
No native C/C++/CUDA/HIP/FlyDSL source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
